verdict.rationale: An editor plugin API is a fair question for a design and animation editor like Rive, but the evidence pack documents no plugin or extension API, typings, samples, or distribution mechanism for editor extensions. What it does show is adjacent: in-file scripting for content behaviors, an MCP connection for AI tools, RML for text-based file authoring, and open-source runtimes. None of these is a way to build and distribute your own editor extensions.

support.subject: As a developer, a documented plugin API with typings and samples lets me build and distribute my own editor extensions
